purpose: Maximum accurate coverage under documented redistribution terms; CC0 is not preferred over other authorised translations.
standard_license_requirements: Verify the exact edition and its publisher or translator license statement
Preserve attribution, copyright, source, complete license notice and license URL
Retain noncommercial and share-alike conditions on texts and downloads
Keep source code licensing separate from text licensing
Never relabel a conditional edition as unrestricted or CC0
explicit_permission: A documented grant for free TXT/HTML redistribution is acceptable; preserve all no-alteration and other conditions.
separate_review: Any ambiguous grant or unknown edition rights

allow.scope: Exact editions with pinned source and text hashes in metadata/source-manifests/licensed-collections.json
allow.evidence_required: The original publisher or translator notice identifies the accepted license and version; complete source comparison passes.
conditions: Retain each edition's attribution, copyright, source and license

allow.scope: Only the exact works and source hashes reviewed in metadata/source-manifests/candana.json
allow.evidence_required: Explicit grant in the source or a recorded publisher statement clearly covering that work; attribution, complete notice and original PDF retained. A grant need not be repeated inside every PDF when its broader scope is documented.
conditions: Copies must be available free of charge
not_authorized: Reuse outside the documented grant's scope

allow.evidence_required: Pinned source manifest and matching source-file record

allow.scope: Cowell et al. Jātaka edition; verified public domain in the United States

allow.license: Public domain in the United States
allow.scope: The two identified 1890 and 1894 Milinda scans only

completeness.preserve_source: Preserve wording, numbering, repetitions, paragraphs and verse structure. Never manufacture expanded repetitions.
